asset().details: Returns the address of the underlying token used for the Vault for accounting, depositing, and withdrawing. - MUST be an ERC-20 token contract. - MUST NOT revert.

returns._0: The address of the base token

params.shares: The amount of shares to convert

decimals().details: Returns the decimals places of the token.

returns._0: The address of the gauge contract

name().details: Returns the name of the token.

symbol().details: Returns the symbol of the token.

totalAssets().details: Returns the total amount of the underlying asset that is “managed” by Vault. - SHOULD include any compounding that occurs from yield. - MUST be inclusive of any fees that are charged against assets in the Vault. - MUST NOT revert.

totalSupply().details: Returns the value of tokens in existence.

CLAIM_FOR_ROLE().notice: Role identifier for claiming on behalf of others

DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE().notice: Role identifier for the default admin role

base().notice: Get the address of the base token

convertToAssets(uint256).notice: Convert an amount of shares to the equivalent amount of assets

gauge().notice: Get the address of the gauge contract

harvester().notice: Get the address of the harvester

nav().notice: Get the net asset value (NAV) of the vault
